body:
When I implemented this, I was following Vulkan restrictions, but did incorrectly copy that logic. 

Curiously, MoltenVK doesn't allow linear tiling on anything but 2D textures, and when I try this demo, I get the following errors in the logs:

```
2025-07-01 06:02:02.732886+1000 Godot[84048:41729192] [ERROR] /Volumes/Data/projects/games/godot/drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:642:_debug_messenger_callback(): VALIDATION - Message Id Number: 0 | Message Id Name: mvk-error
	VK_ERROR_MEMORY_MAP_FAILED: Private GPU-only memory cannot be mapped to host memory.
	Objects - 1
		Object[0] - VK_OBJECT_TYPE_DEVICE_MEMORY, Handle 5826716576 VALIDATION - Message Id Number: 0 | Message Id Name: mvk-error
	VK_ERROR_MEMORY_MAP_FAILED: Private GPU-only memory cannot be mapped to host memory.
	Objects - 1
		Object[0] - VK_OBJECT_TYPE_DEVICE_MEMORY, Handle 5826716576
   GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):
       [0] textureTest (res://test_overhead.gd:99)
       [1] _ready (res://test_overhead.gd:111)
```

According to the [Vulkan spec](https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/resources.html), linear tiling has fairly strict restrictions and may only be supported on 2D images, which is where my checks essentially come from:

> Images created with tiling equal to `VK_IMAGE_TILING_LINEAR` have further restrictions on their limits and capabilities compared to images created with tiling equal to `VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL`. Creation of images with tiling `VK_IMAGE_TILING_LINEAR` may not be supported unless other parameters meet all of the constraints:
> 
> * `imageType` is `VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D`
> * `format` is not a depth/stencil format
> * `mipLevels` is 1
> * `arrayLayers` is 1
> * `samples` is `VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT`
> * `usage` only includes `VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT` and/or `VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT`

I also flipped the `ERR_FAIL_COND_V_MSG()` before opening this issue.  I just encountered enough errors while trying various combinations for the texture format that I had to accept this wasn't something I knew enough about to work through a solution.

Is there a `RDTextureFormat` that should work for `TEXTURE_USAGE_CPU_READ_BIT` when the `ERR_FAIL_COND_V_MSG(ft = ...)` conditions are flipped?  I'm happy to test combinations.
